Name: colorful flower dance outfits - CP
Author: katochalol
Description:
The Flower Dance is nice and all, but the plain white dresses and blue onesies didn't give me enough serotonin, so I thought I'd change it up a bit and make things more colorful. 

[u]Requirements:[/u]
Content Patcher


[u]Content:[/u]
This comes with a CONFIG file, so you can change who the mod is active for, and it uses an overlay instead of an image replacement so it [i]should[/i] be compatible with everything except other mods that's change the pixels. 

I put fruits and flowers on the girls' dresses to really pull them more into the spirit of the flower dance. It's pixel art so you'll have to extend your imagination, though.
Abigail - Crocus
Emily - Red Tulip
Haley - Sunflower
Leah - Wild Plum
Maru - Strawberry
Penny - Poppy

The couples match each others' colors. 
Red - Harvey and Maru
Pink - Alex and Haley
Orange/Yellow - Sam and Penny
Green - Elliott and Leah
Blue - Shane and Emily
Purple - Sebastian and Abigail


[u]Config:[/u]
The config file just shows each of the characters' names followed by a boolean (true is the default for all of them). If you want to disable one, just change the "true" to a "false". 


[u]Future Updates:[/u]
- I'm thinking about making the outfits interchangeable, as in if you wanted to put Emily in red, that would be an option. As I'm currently job hunting, it's not at the top of my priorities list at the moment, but if enough of you actually want something like that let me know and I'll see what I can do. 
- Having the option to swap the clothing between genders would also be nice, I think. But as before, I'll only do it if enough people are interested.


[u]Compatibility:[/u]
- Should be compatible with everything that doesn't change the flower dance outfits for the NPCs.


[u]Installation Instructions:[/u] 
It's a ZIP file, so if you're on Windows, just extract it into your ".../SteamLibrary/steamapps/common/Stardew Valley/Mods" folder




This is my first Stardew Mod that I'm posting, and the first one I've actually messed with the coding for. If you find a bug, just post it and a description of what's going on and how you encountered it so I can best resolve the issue. 

Note: Elliott's hair is long, so it comes over the back of his shirt, which means that if you have a mod that gives him short hair, his shirt will not go up to his collar in the sprite.
